# Shree Garud IT Solutions

Shree Garud IT Solutions is an IT services company based in Gurugram, Haryana, India, providing managed IT infrastructure, networking, cloud, security, and hardware services to small and mid-sized businesses.

## Services

We offer 11 core service lines:
- IT Infrastructure Management
- Networking Solutions
- Rental Laptop & Desktop
- Cloud Solutions
- Security Solutions
- Software Licensing Solutions
- Audio Visual
- Annual Facility Maintenance (AMC)
- Mailing Solutions (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)
- Designing Software (Adobe, Corel, AutoCAD licensing)
- E-waste Collection

Full details for each service are available at /services and /services/{service-slug}.

## Key pages

- /services — full list of services with descriptions
- /shop — browse current hardware/software stock and request a quote
- /careers — open job postings and applications
- /about — company background and team
- /contact — contact form and location
